subject.title: fix(gateway): don't retire parent Codex binding when creating a detached dashboard child

question: Should OpenClaw expose `succeedsParent` as a durable public `sessions.create` lifecycle contract now that current main already protects the reported Codex parent-binding failure?
rationale: The patch is a broader gateway protocol and session-lifecycle design change, not merely the already-fixed observed Codex regression; source evidence does not establish that all present and out-of-tree session creators should declare this disposition.

options.title: Keep the current consumer safeguard
options.body: Do not add a new gateway parameter unless a remaining generic lifecycle failure is demonstrated beyond the already-fixed Codex case.

options.title: Adopt explicit succession
options.body: Accept `succeedsParent` as a public contract and require owner-approved semantics plus compatibility coverage for all supported protocol clients.

recommendation.title: Keep the current consumer safeguard
recommendation.body: Do not add a new gateway parameter unless a remaining generic lifecycle failure is demonstrated beyond the already-fixed Codex case.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Control UI lifecycle-hook work is the strongest feature-history provenance for the intended create-versus-replace semantics.
